summary: Mission Produce, Inc. filed an 8-K to report financial results for the quarter ended April 30, 2026, and disclose a new $100 million stock repurchase program authorized by the Board on June 3, 2026, replacing the prior program with $11.2 million remaining. The buyback runs 36 months with no fixed price or expiration. The filing also notes the completed May 28, 2026 acquisition of Calavo Growers. The repurchase represents a capital return to shareholders. Watch for buyback execution pace and potential impact on share price; no risk-arb angle as this is an issuer buyback.
